entries.text: My dear friends! How ARE you all today?\nFeeling absolutely fantastic, I hope?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_02_language_01

entries.text: It’s time for Salvatore’s Language Lesson!\nÊtes-vous prêts—are you ready, everyone?\r\nYou can answer with “Yes” or “Oui”![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_02_language_02

entries.text: Yes!
entries.label: class_d_02_yes_01

entries.text: Oui!
entries.label: class_d_02_yes_02

entries.text: C’est super![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_02_language_03

entries.text: In our last class, I believe I taught you all how to\nsay “thank you” in other languages, right?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_02_language_04

entries.text: In le cours d’aujourd’hui—today’s class—we will\nlearn about a certain word sure to make people\r\nhappy when you use it in your travels abroad![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_02_language_05

entries.text: What word, you ask? Well, you’ll have to guess!\nDélicieux! Hǎochī! Buono! Can anyone tell me\r\nwhat these words mean?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_02_language_06

entries.text: Delicious
entries.label: class_d_02_select_01

entries.text: Sorry
entries.label: class_d_02_select_02

entries.text: Help
entries.label: class_d_02_select_03

entries.text: Waouh! Correct! C’est super! I knew I could\ncount on you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_02_language_answer_01

entries.text:
Oh, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\c
If sorry really did “cut it,” as they say, the justice
system would be inutile—unnecessary! Sorry,
but that’s a mauvaise réponse—a wrong answer![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_02_language_answer_02

entries.text:
Oh, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\c
I hear your SOS! Don’t worry! I’ll SAVE you,
or my name’s not Salvatore! That was a mauvaise
réponse—a wrong answer—but I hear you![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_02_language_answer_03

entries.text: Délicieux! Hǎochī! Buono! All of these words\nmean “delicious”![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_02_language_07

entries.text: Using the local word for “delicious” at markets or\nrestaurants is sure to get a big sourire—a smile,\r\nthat is—from whoever you’re talking to![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_02_language_08

entries.text: It’ll make communication go more smoothly—\nI guarantee it![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_02_language_09

entries.text: People love it when someone says the cuisine of\ntheir homeland is delicious! Who wouldn’t be\r\nheureux—happy—to receive such a compliment?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_02_language_10

entries.text: And now, apropos of nothing, let me give you\nall one of my wise words of advice![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_02_language_11

entries.text: The first step to smooth communication is to\ncompliment the person you’re talking to![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_02_language_12

entries.text: After all, it’s not very likely that a compliment\nwould put someone in a bad mood![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_02_language_13

entries.text: This doesn’t only apply to people in other\nregions, either! It’s the same for all of you, too!\r\nYou can put this tip to use with your classmates![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_02_language_14

entries.text: How about you all try complimenting each other\nafter class? I bet it will make for an ambiance\r\nplus sympathique—a more friendly atmosphere![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_02_language_15

entries.text: That’s all for today! See you all au prochain\ncours—next lesson, that is! Adios! Mata ne![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_02_language_16
